# `askAgent(options.provider, [options.messages], [options.prompt], [options.system], [options.history], [options.images], [options.documents], [options.attachments], [options.media], [options.config], [options.configOptions], [options.tools], [options.toolHandlers], [options.documentResolver], [options.mcpServers], [options.approveToolCall], [options.preSearch], [options.webSearch], [options.webSearchFn], [options.maxToolRounds], [options.includeDiagnostics], [options.autoCompact], [options.compactionThresholdPercent], [options.compactionKeepLastMessages], [options.compactionStrategy], [options.responseProcessing], [options.signal], [options.onTextDelta], [options.onThinking], [options.onToolStart], [options.onToolFinish], [options.capabilities], [options.interactive], [options.mode], [options.onUserInputRequest], [options.usage])`

[External Documentation](https://github.com/rdsslab/libAgentKit/blob/main/docs/AGENT_API_GUIDE.md) 

Stateless, provider-agnostic agent turn from `@rdsslab/agentkit`. Deterministic web pre-search, in-memory documents and media attachments, local tools, MCP servers with trust approvals, bounded context injections, grounding checks and optional streaming. Returns one consistent envelope across Ollama, OpenAI-compatible providers, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, Mistral and xAI.

**Notes**

- `askAgent` is stateless: pass the full `messages`/`history` on every call, or use `AgentSession` for multi-turn conversations with recall and auto-compaction.
- The deterministic pre-search fixes the common failure of small local models that answer "no tengo acceso a internet" even when a search tool is available. `preSearch: 'auto'` also detects URLs.
- Documents and media are processed in memory because JS handlers have no filesystem: pass bytes or data URLs, not paths.
- Web and tool recaps are capped to the free context of each turn; `injectedContext` reports the total and its breakdown by source.
- MCP trust levels fail closed: `untrusted` tools need `approveToolCall`, and `disabled` servers are never connected.
- A `MediaProviderError`, `DocumentExtractionError` or `AgentError` carries a `userMessage` that can be shown to the end user verbatim.

**Agent Guidance**

- Use `askAgent` for one isolated turn; use `AgentSession` when the answer depends on previous turns, recall or automatic compaction.
- Prefer it over `askIAWithMCP` when you need web access, documents or media: it does the plumbing for you.
- Keep `maxToolRounds` low (2-4) for slow local models; each round is a full prompt processing pass.
- Read provider URLs and keys from `$_APP_VARS_`; never take credentials from `request.body` or `request.query`.
- For deterministic tests inject `webSearchFn` and pass an explicit `config`; do not depend on live search or host config files.
- Return only `text` and small metadata to the caller. Keep `diagnostics` in logs, not in the HTTP response.

**Parameters**

*   `options.provider` <object|string> Provider config accepted by the IA layer (or a preset name such as `ollama`, `openai`, `openai-compatible`, `openrouter`, `deepseek`, `anthropic`, `google-gemini`). Must include `model`; `contextLength` enables context budgeting. Use App Vars for base URLs and API keys.
*   `options.messages` <array<object>|string> **Optional**. Conversation messages, oldest first: `[{ role, content }]`. Content may be a string or an array of text/image parts.
*   `options.prompt` <string> **Optional**. Shorthand for a single user message.
*   `options.system` <string> **Optional**. System prompt prepended to the conversation.
*   `options.history` <array<object>> **Optional**. Prior conversation, oldest first, prepended to `messages`. For multi-turn conversations prefer `AgentSession`, which owns the history.
*   `options.images` <array<any>> **Optional**. Images for the last user turn: Buffers, base64 strings, data URLs or `{ mimeType, data }`.
*   `options.documents` <array<any>> **Optional**. In-memory documents whose text is extracted and injected into the prompt: Buffers, base64, data URLs or `{ data, mimeType, fileName }`. Supported: PDF, DOCX and text formats.
*   `options.attachments` <array<object>> **Optional**. Unified media items `{ kind, data, mimeType, name }`; `kind` can be inferred from the MIME type. Images are native; documents are extracted to text; audio/video use STT or frames unless native media is declared on the provider.
*   `options.media` <object> **Optional**. Media processing options: `{ maxFrames, frameWidth, timeoutMs, language, onError, stt }`.
*   `options.config` <object> **Optional**. Effective AgentKit config override. STT is read from `config.stt` or `config.media.stt`.
*   `options.configOptions` <object> **Optional**. Options forwarded to `loadEffectiveConfig()` when `config` is absent. Pass an explicit config for reproducible runs.
*   `options.tools` <object> **Optional**. Tools to enable: `{ web_search: true, read_document: true, [customName]: { handler, inputSchema } }`. A plain function is accepted as a shorthand handler.
*   `options.toolHandlers` <object> **Optional**. Extra local tool handlers merged into `tools` (same shape as `askIAWithProviderMCP`).
*   `options.documentResolver` <function> **Optional**. Optional `async ({ name, id }) => document` used by the `read_document` tool when documents are not injected directly.
*   `options.mcpServers` <array<object>> **Optional**. MCP servers connected for this turn. Supports HTTP and stdio transports plus `trusted`, `untrusted` and `disabled` levels.
*   `options.approveToolCall` <function> **Optional**. Hook `({ serverName, toolName, toolAlias, arguments }) => boolean|{approved}` required for tools of `untrusted` MCP servers. Without it those calls fail closed.
*   `options.preSearch` <boolean|string> **Optional**. Default: `auto`. Deterministic web search before the model: `"auto"` (default: explicit search requests and URLs), `true`/`"always"`, or `false` (never).
*   `options.webSearch` <object> **Optional**. Options forwarded to `webSearch()`: `providers`, `maxResults`, `timeoutMs`, `maxInjectedContextChars`, `preSearch`...
*   `options.webSearchFn` <function> **Optional**. Optional search function injected for tests/CI. Receives the merged web-search config (`query`, `maxResults`, `signal`...) and returns a `webSearch()`-shaped result.
*   `options.maxToolRounds` <integer> **Optional**. Default: `4`. Maximum tool rounds before forcing a final answer.
*   `options.includeDiagnostics` <boolean> **Optional**. When true, returns full documents and the raw provider diagnostics (including `usage` and detailed `toolExecutions`) under `diagnostics`; the default path returns only the provider text and an empty `toolExecutions` summary.
*   `options.autoCompact` <boolean|object> **Optional**. Compact the supplied history before the provider call; useful when driving `askAgent()` directly with long histories.
*   `options.compactionThresholdPercent` <number> **Optional**. Default: `25`. Estimated context usage that triggers compaction when `autoCompact` is enabled.
*   `options.compactionKeepLastMessages` <integer> **Optional**. Default: `12`. Recent messages kept when compaction uses the truncate strategy.
*   `options.compactionStrategy` <string> **Optional**. Default: `summary`. Compaction strategy: `"summary"` (default) or `"truncate"`.
*   `options.responseProcessing` <boolean|object> **Optional**. Optional deterministic post-processing: repair partial output, extract code blocks, detect refusals and validate minimum content. Disabled by default for chat.
*   `options.signal` <AbortSignal> **Optional**. Optional AbortSignal to cancel the request.
*   `options.onTextDelta` <function> **Optional**. Optional streaming callback `(delta, meta) => void`. When present the provider uses its streaming path; without it the non-streaming path is unchanged.
*   `options.onThinking` <function> **Optional**. Optional callback for real provider reasoning deltas (Ollama `thinking`, OpenAI `reasoning_content`, Anthropic/Gemini thinking parts).
*   `options.onToolStart` <function> **Optional**. Optional observer invoked when a tool call starts.
*   `options.onToolFinish` <function> **Optional**. Optional observer invoked when a tool call finishes.
*   `options.capabilities` <object> **Optional**. Capability gates for tools. Missing categories are filled in; embedded hosts fail closed for `terminal` and `filesystem`. A per-tool override wins over its category.
*   `options.interactive` <boolean> **Optional**. Marks an interactive host so capability defaults can enable terminal/filesystem tools. Keep false in HTTP handlers.
*   `options.mode` <string> **Optional**. Default: `build`. Harness mode reported in the envelope, e.g. `"build"` (default) or `"ask"`.
*   `options.onUserInputRequest` <function> **Optional**. Optional hook used by tools that need to ask the user a question in interactive hosts.
*   `options.usage` <boolean> **Optional**. Default: `true`. Whether to include provider token usage in the envelope when available.

*   Returns: <object> Promise resolving to the same envelope for every provider.

    **Result Structure:**

    *   `text` <string> Assistant answer.
    *   `usedWeb` <boolean> True when deterministic pre-search or a `web_search` tool result was injected.
    *   `webQuery` <string> Query used by the web search.
    *   `webResults` <array<object>> Results `{ title, url, snippet }`.
    *   `webSource` <string|null> Engine that answered the search.
    *   `webErrors` <array<string>> Per-provider search errors, when any.
    *   `documents` <array<object>> Injected document metadata (full text only with `includeDiagnostics`).
    *   `media` <object> Normalized images/audio/video frames sent with the turn.
    *   `toolExecutions` <array<object>> Summary `{ tool, server, ok, deduplicated }`. With the default `includeDiagnostics: false` this array is empty; the detailed log lives in `diagnostics.toolExecutions` when diagnostics are requested.
    *   `hasTools` <boolean> True when any tool was offered to the model.
    *   `mode` <string> Effective harness mode.
    *   `usage` <object|null> Provider token usage when the provider layer exposes diagnostics; `null` on the default non-diagnostics path.
    *   `injectedContextChars` <number> Total characters injected from media, documents, web and tools.
    *   `injectedContext` <object> Character breakdown: `{ media, documents, web, tools }`.
    *   `diagnostics` <object> Raw `ia.js` diagnostics only when `includeDiagnostics` is true; includes full documents, `toolExecutions` and `usage`.
    *   `incomplete/reason/compaction` <any> Optional diagnostic flags for partial answers, stop reasons and compaction; present with `includeDiagnostics: true`.

#### Example

```javascript

const answer = await askAgent({
  provider: {
    provider: 'ollama',
    model: 'llama3.2:3b',
    baseUrl: $_APP_VARS_['$_VAR_OLLAMA_URL'],
    contextLength: 8192,
  },
  system: 'Responde en espanol, breve y sin inventar datos.',
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Busca el precio del dolar hoy' }],
  tools: { web_search: true },
  preSearch: 'auto',
  maxToolRounds: 3,
});

$_RETURN_DATA_ = {
  text: answer.text,
  usedWeb: answer.usedWeb,
  usage: answer.usage,
};
      
```
